description: This is a unit test file for the php_zip_utils.php utility functions within the SuiteCRM project. It tests functions related to zipping and unzipping files and directories, confirms file existence after operations, and handles cleanup. The test class inherits from a custom PHPUnit framework class and uses test methods to verify behavior of zip utilities.

classes.name: php_zip_utilsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying zip utility functions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testunzip
methods.description: Tests the unzip function by creating, unzipping, and verifying existence of specific files.

methods.name: testunzip_file
methods.description: Tests the unzip_file function similarly by creating, unzipping, and checking files.

methods.name: testzip_dir
methods.description: Tests zipping a directory and confirms that the zip file is created.

methods.name: testzip_files_list
methods.description: Tests zipping a list of files and confirms the creation of the zip archive.
